data.body: RP-01 S4 CI Verified -1 (patchset 2, ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13): the reusable _build-and-test.yml gate workflow is resolved from TRUSTED MAIN (only the patchset source is checked out), so my in-patchset --extra tracing edit never applied. Root cause: the require-extras lane arms tests/_extra_guard.py which forbids importorskip-dodging a missing extra, and [tracing] (opentelemetry.sdk) is deliberately excluded there (real-SDK tracing is external-tier, cf tests/external/test_llm_trace.py). Also: external-marked tests are CONFINED to tests/external/ (tests/conftest.py:211). Fix: reverted the workflow edit; RELOCATED the AC-1/AC-2 real-OTel nesting test to a self-contained, import-safe tests/external/test_candidate_tracing_live.py (heavy imports inside functions so the lean unit lane collects it cleanly, then -m 'not external' deselects it). RecordingTracer tests keep the AC-1/AC-2 span/order/attribute contract in CI. Verified: module imports with opentelemetry blocked; armed unit-lane 7 passed + 1 deselected; external test green under REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1; lint+typecheck 0. Pushed patchset 3.
